policies.policy_name: Administrator Role Required for Service Updates
policies.description: Only users with the Administrator role (admin) may invoke the update_service tool; users in any other role are prohibited from updating Service records.
references: | **Administrator** (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |
| **Manager** (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. |

| **Agent** (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | **Full CRUD** on **Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge**. READ access to all the tables. |

policies.policy_name: Service Update Must Include Mandatory Field service_id
policies.description: Every invocation of update_service must include the mandatory field `service_id` that identifies the service to be updated.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.policy_name: Service Update Must Include At Least One Additional Field
policies.description: An update_service request must provide at least one updatable field in addition to `service_id` (e.g., name, owned_by, status, etc.).
references: At least one field must be provided. Service name must be unique if provided.

policies.description: The `service_id` supplied to update_service must be verified via a prior lookup; identifiers must never be fabricated.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.
When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.

policies.description: The update_service operation must be performed as a single atomic action, without bundling other actions in the same request.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.
